name: Outlaw Tools v0.10.1
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.10.1

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.10.1

## Data Sources

- Settings shows builds, providers, timestamps and freshness for ships, FPS equipment, crafting products, Blueprints, missions, mining signatures, mining locations and public economy data.
- Distinguish exact builds, different hotfixes, family-only evidence, mismatches and unknowns against the selected game channel. Build compatibility and freshness are separate checks.
- Select a source for provenance and recovery guidance. Recheck reads local metadata; it does not download or activate data. Fresh prices never certify mechanics compatibility.
- Provider-specific failures no longer mark unrelated resource feeds failed. Retained/bundled data and unknown timestamps remain explicit.
- Correct game build detection to use the selected channel instead of always labelling it LIVE.

## Performance and Storage

- Read compact SQLite metadata through the existing worker without full catalogs, quote payloads or player profiles. Hidden views retire pending results.
- No player-data migration, hosted player data or new runtime dependency.

## Downloads

- Windows installer and Linux x86_64 archive, with SHA-256 checksums.
